```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(crosstalk)

file_path <- "C:/MRM/docs/other/xlsx/LandUseStat.xlsx"

counties <- excel_sheets(file_path)

data_all <- lapply(counties, function(cty) {

  df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = cty)

  section_names <- c(
    "Population and Households",
    "Employment",
    "Students"
  )

  df$Category <- ifelse(
    df[[1]] %in% section_names,
    df[[1]],
    NA
  )

  df <- fill(df, Category)

  df$County <- cty

  df

}) %>%
  bind_rows()
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
data_all$.row_id <- seq_len(nrow(data_all))
# Make a copy for displaying in the table
data_display <- data_all

# Identify numeric columns
num_cols <- sapply(data_display, is.numeric)

# Format numeric columns
data_display[num_cols] <- lapply(
  data_display[num_cols],
  function(x) {
    ifelse(
      is.na(x),
      NA,
      ifelse(
        x == floor(x),
        formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0),
        formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)
      )
    )
  }
)

# IMPORTANT: shared_data must use data_display
shared_data <- SharedData$new(
  data_display,
  key = ~.row_id,
  group = "landuse"
)
# shared_data <- SharedData$new(
#   data_all,
#   key = ~.row_id,
#   group = "landuse"
# )
```



```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# County filter - select ONE county
filter_select(
  id = "county",
  label = "Select County:",
  sharedData = shared_data,
  group = ~County,
  multiple = FALSE
)

# SE Data filter - select ONE category
filter_select(
  id = "category",
  label = "Select SE Data:",
  sharedData = shared_data,
  group = ~Category,
  multiple = FALSE
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

htmltools::tags$script(
  htmltools::HTML("
    
    function setupTableVisibility() {
      
      var countyDiv = document.getElementById('county');
      var categoryDiv = document.getElementById('category');
      
      // Wait until Crosstalk/Selectize has created the controls
      if (!countyDiv || !categoryDiv ||
          !countyDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized').length ||
          !categoryDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized').length) {
        
        setTimeout(setupTableVisibility, 100);
        return;
      }
      
      var countySelect =
        countyDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized')[0].selectize;
      
      var categorySelect =
        categoryDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized')[0].selectize;
      
      var table = document.getElementById('data_table_container');
      
      if (!table) {
        return;
      }
      
      function checkFilters() {
        
        var county = countySelect.getValue();
        var category = categorySelect.getValue();
        
        // Show table ONLY when both filters have a selection
        if (county && category) {
          table.style.display = '';
        } else {
          table.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
      
      // Run when County changes
      countySelect.on('change', checkFilters);
      
      // Run when SE Data changes
      categorySelect.on('change', checkFilters);
      
      // Hide table initially
      checkFilters();
    }
    
    $(document).ready(function() {
      setupTableVisibility();
    });
    
  ")
)
```
